records.outcome: 6 tests passed; full-fixture comparison failed while reading the Python oracle JSON, before native fact comparison
records.diagnostic: serde_json unexpected end of hex escape at the isolated-surrogate literal
records.root_cause: Python json.dumps can emit a lone surrogate escape, but project machine JSON must contain scalar Unicode. The valid DEX literal was incorrectly used as an ordinary JSON string in an independent oracle artifact.
records.fix: Encode the oracle/layout non-scalar value as tagged UTF16 units plus raw MUTF8 where available. Keep original DEX bytes unchanged. Native facts retain UTF16 and plain UTF8 projection remains explicit UnsupportedQuery rather than replacement.
records.scope: Artifact encoding correction only; no parser, fixture bytes or semantic expectation was relaxed.
